name: cybara
description: Open-source multi-agent AI platform — CLI, web UI, and desktop apps with 71 tools, 50 LLM providers, MCP host/client, media generation, and multi-agent orchestration.

scripts.dev: bun run build && cd ui && bun run build && cd .. && bun run --watch src/index.ts
scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external electron --external @noble/hashes --external @scure/bip39 --external @scure/base
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli.tsx --outdir dist --target bun --external electron --external @noble/hashes --external @scure/bip39 --external @scure/base
scripts.build:main: bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external electron --external @noble/hashes --external @scure/bip39 --external @scure/base
scripts.build:all: bun run ui:build && bun run build && bun run build:cli && bun run build:main
scripts.start:prod: bun run build:all && bun run start
scripts.check:ci: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:loc && bun run test:smoke && bun run deadcode:report
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.test:smoke: bun run test:core && bun test tests/runtime && bun test tests/api/security.test.ts tests/api/browser-routes-mocked.test.ts tests/api/channel-security-routes-mocked.test.ts && bun test tests/e2e/security-auth-smoke.test.ts tests/e2e/chat-logs-metrics-smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:smoke:full: bun run test:core && bun test tests/runtime && bun test tests/api/security.test.ts tests/api/browser-routes-mocked.test.ts tests/api/channel-security-routes-mocked.test.ts && bun test tests/e2e
scripts.test: bun test tests/core tests/api tests/channels tests/cli tests/runtime
scripts.sexy: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.sexy:write: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format
scripts.tauri:dev: bun run tauri:dev:prep && bun run tauri:sidecar && bunx tauri dev
scripts.tauri:dev:prep: bun run scripts/prepare-tauri-dev.ts && bun run package
scripts.tauri:build: bun run tauri:sidecar && bunx tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:release: bun run tauri:sidecar && bun run tauri:prepare-release && bunx tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json

author: Carsen Klock
build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external electron
build:cli: bun build src/cli.tsx --outdir dist --target bun --external electron
build:main: bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external electron
